headline: Ranked build-ahead de-risk shortlist for the mouth read-power wall (#80): the banked cross-arc record (every FIXED read refuted on both read-power cruxes; two nonlinear-expansion reads failed to lift a ceiling) puts the BUILT Urbanczik-Senn apical-teacher incumbent + a variance-weighted learned local read rule at the top and a cheapest-first information-limiting diagnostic as the gate to run FIRST; the pending coverage/epochs GO demotes the whole list to background build-ahead while a FLAT makes rank-1 merge+queue the load-bearing next action — a research-scoping prior, not a validated GO.

ranked_shortlist.mechanism: Urbanczik-Senn two-compartment apical-teacher read (the BUILT incumbent): keep the existing feedforward hid/hidinh graded-conductance margin as the BASAL prediction pathway, add an APICAL compartment (target-driven labelled-line excitatory teacher per (block,word) + tonic inhibitory non-target baseline) as a SECOND, independent spiking substrate read; the local error is per-unit err = sigma(apical) - sigma(basal), replacing the cross-unit softmax over the single noisy basal read, with a local delta update W += lr*err@h + decay (no weight transport, no host gradient). This is the pre-registered contingency the ensemble NO-GO escalated to active.
ranked_shortlist.grounding: Urbanczik & Senn, 'Learning by the Dendritic Prediction of Somatic Spiking', Neuron 81:521-528 (2014), PMID 24507189; framed as local dendritic-compartment prediction error by Mikulasch et al., Trends Neurosci 46:45-59 (2023), PMID 36577388. ANCHORED in a resolved project binding: research/biology/urbanczik-senn-dendritic-prediction.md (Kandel PNS 6e back-propagating-AP anchors resolve). The SAME rule already shipped on the live bridge for the error-SOURCE (research/findings/2026-08-19-neural-error-onbridge-GO.md, NEURAL-onbridge=0.929). CAVEAT the synthesis must carry: that binding explicitly scopes U-S to the error-source and states it does NOT touch the mouth READ-REGIME, so applying it as a read-SNR lever is a NEW use of the framework whose efficacy is genuinely open.
ranked_shortlist.first_derisk: Already done at the wiring/anti-cheat level (byte-identical OFF verified against pre-edit baseline; ON smoke: host_matmul_on_forward=0, main_apical_reads==n_grad_steps, apical calibration sign m_target>m_nontarget, sub_shuffle_recov ~0.0003, sub_freeze_apical_recov ~0 so the teacher is load-bearing, verify_first_ok=true). The ONLY remaining de-risk is the decisive run: merge research/mouth-read-snr-dendritic to main (the live gpu_queue runs from the main checkout), then queue the staged 6-seed job. Smoke go=false at 12 steps (sub_learned~0.39) is expected and explicitly non-decisive.
ranked_shortlist.go_gate: Pre-registered (unchanged): per-seed GO = integrated sub_learned_recov >= 0.85 x sub_copied_recov OR decisive lift sub_learned_recov >= 0.55, AND all four anti-cheat/dendritic-anti-cheat conditions hold (apical-shuffle collapses, freeze-apical collapses to ~0, host_matmul_on_forward==0, apical calibration sign m_target>m_nontarget). Board GO = >=5/6 seeds (42,43,44,100,101,102) at production scale (B=48, w-target 40, matched windows).
ranked_shortlist.lane: small-GPU-queue (decisive run; build DONE) + a trivial agent-build (haiku/sonnet tier) only to merge the branch to main
ranked_shortlist.expected_cost: One sequential GPU job at production B=48 x 6 seeds, comparable to the pending coverage/epochs run (order hours). Build cost already sunk. Merge is mechanical. Near-zero marginal Claude tokens.
ranked_shortlist.verdict_conditional_note: If pending readout GOes: the dendritic run is answering the DEEPER ~0.34-0.37 read-power plateau, NOT the residual the GO just closed - so it stays worth running for its own target but DROPS from load-bearing to a background build-ahead de-risk (the mouth crutch-burndown proceeds on the coverage-tuned substrate-forward without it). If pending readout is FLAT: this becomes THE load-bearing next action - merge+queue is the critical path, and the wall framing upgrades to a genuine architecture-level ceiling on the single-compartment softmax-over-noisy-basal read.

ranked_shortlist.mechanism: Variance-weighted / learned-gain regularized LOCAL read rule: replace the fixed mean-difference/1:1 estimator in the basal read (or the apical error combination) with a biologically-plausible local delta/perceptron update whose per-channel gain is down-weighted where the train-fold estimate is noise-dominated (a variance-aware optimal-linear-estimator-style combination). Composes with rank 1 (regularizes the apical local error) or stands alone on the basal read.
ranked_shortlist.grounding: This is the read-fidelity arc's OWN ranked-#1 residual, promoted by evidence not opinion: the opponent/push-pull NO-GO (research/findings/2026-08-28-read-fidelity-opponent-pushpull-NOGO-...md, 6-seed 0/6, net WORSE than the single channel) diagnosed that unregularized full-power sign-recovery ADDS variance without matching signal - the read-power gap is 'a full-power estimator built naively is not automatically more powerful than a well-regularized one'. Grounded in Salinas & Abbott, 'Vector reconstruction from firing rates', J Comput Neurosci 1:89-107 (1994) - the optimal-linear-estimator down-weights noisy channels; delta/perceptron local rules are standard substrate-realizable plasticity. Same signature across both cruxes: every FIXED read (rectified template, opponent, popvec) failed; the LEARNED+regularized direction is the least-refuted.
ranked_shortlist.first_derisk: Cheap numpy replay on the ALREADY-recorded hid/hidinh traces + captured rasters (reused verbatim from the read-fidelity iterations, no retraining): fit a variance-weighted local delta read on a TRAIN fold of neuron identities, evaluate on the HELD-OUT fold; A/B against the fixed mean-difference/1:1 estimator as a clean single-variable change.
ranked_shortlist.go_gate: Cheap-gate: held-out sub_learned_recov (or delta_held_base z on the F2 sibling) with the variance-weighted local rule EXCEEDS the fixed-estimator baseline beyond a neuron-identity-permutation null at >=5/6 seeds, AND the gain survives held-out CV (not in-sample). Only then fund the substrate build + a decisive 6-seed GPU run re-applying the rank-1 integrated bar (>=5/6 seeds, ratio>=0.85).
ranked_shortlist.lane: CPU-pool (cheap de-risk on existing traces) -> agent-build (substrate delta-rule read, sonnet tier) -> small-GPU-queue (decisive)
ranked_shortlist.expected_cost: Cheap de-risk: hours on the CPU pool, reuses existing data, no new sim run, near-zero marginal cost. Full build: moderate agent-build. Cost-routed: sonnet for the reanalysis/build, opus only to interpret the decisive run.
ranked_shortlist.verdict_conditional_note: If pending readout GOes: opportunistic idle-lane de-risk for the deep plateau only; not on the mouth critical path. If FLAT: this becomes the highest-value CHEAP parallel lever to run BESIDE rank 1's decisive run - it is better-supported by the banked negatives than any nonlinear-expansion lever and directly targets the mechanism the opponent NO-GO implicated (unregularized estimation noise).

ranked_shortlist.mechanism: Differential-correlation / information-limiting DIAGNOSTIC (a decision gate, not a read-power mechanism): compute the leading eigenvector of the read's trial-to-trial noise covariance (from already-collected repeated reads at fixed weights) and its cosine alignment to the signal direction (head_w), against a neuron-identity-permutation null. Bundle the MANDATORY wall-survives-cache-fix recheck (re-run the fresh-build-per-probe structured-vs-random decode check post stale-COO-fix) into the same sweep.
ranked_shortlist.grounding: Moreno-Bote, Beck, Kanitscheider, Pitkow, Latham & Pouget, 'Information-limiting correlations', Nat Neurosci 17:1410-1417 (2014); Pitkow & Meister (2012). If the noise-covariance leading eigenvector aligns with head_w, the limit is information-limiting: NO amount of same-population pooling/expansion can help (which independently EXPLAINS the ensemble --sub-pop INERT NO-GO and the common-mode-cancellation fingerprint), and information must come from an INDEPENDENT pathway - exactly what rank 1's apical teacher supplies. This is the project's 'the instrument is part of the emulation' discipline.
ranked_shortlist.first_derisk: IS the de-risk: half-day CPU/numpy on the SAME repeated-read data already gathered (the K-read-averaging traces). No new sim run, no build. Fold in candidate-7's population-decorrelation eigenvalue diagnostic (same replayed activity) at marginal extra cost.
ranked_shortlist.go_gate: DECISION gate (no read-power GO claimed): report per-seed cosine(noise-cov leading eigenvector, head_w) vs a neuron-identity-permutation null p-value across all 6 seeds. Aligned-above-null in >=4/6 seeds => VERDICT information-limiting => prioritize the independent-pathway family (ranks 1,2), predict same-population recoding (ranks 5,6) futile, do NOT fund them. Not-aligned => recoding family is viable, release the cheap rank-5 sweep. The bundled recheck: PROCEED with any recoding build ONLY IF structured-direction decode still << random-direction decode after the cache-fix (the cupy structure-characterization wall was retracted once as a stale-COO artifact, 0.96 vs 0.95).
ranked_shortlist.expected_cost: Cheapest of the shortlist: half-day CPU, zero new data/runs, zero build. Highest cheapness-x-decisiveness even though its direct read-power upside is zero (it is a sequencing gate).
ranked_shortlist.verdict_conditional_note: Independent of the pending readout GO/FLAT - run it FIRST temporally in EITHER branch, because it cheaply adjudicates whether the whole architecture family attacks a real, non-information-limited target before any GPU is spent. If FLAT it is the load-bearing FIRST move that routes between rank-1/2 (independent pathway) and rank-5 (recoding); if GO it still cheaply characterizes the deep plateau for the background track.

ranked_shortlist.mechanism: Nonlinear dendritic-subunit refinement of the still-LINEAR basal compartment: partition hid/hidinh into K local branch subsets, apply an independent local sigmoidal (NMDA-spike-like) nonlinearity per subset, then linearly pool the K subunit outputs into the somatic margin - a shallow dendrite-then-soma MLP replacing the single global-linear conductance sum. Strongest form (given candidate 4): drop the K nonlinear subunits INSIDE the already-built incumbent's basal compartment, feeding the existing apical-taught local error, so it COMPOSES with rank 1 rather than competing.
ranked_shortlist.grounding: Poirazi, Brannon & Mel, 'Pyramidal Neuron as Two-Layer Neural Network', Neuron 37:989-999 (2003); Polsky, Mel & Schiller, 'Computational subunits in thin dendrites of pyramidal cells', Nat Neurosci 7:621-627 (2004); Jadi, Behabadi, Poleg-Polsky, Schiller & Mel, Proc IEEE 102(5) (2014), PMID 25554708. COUNTERVAILING INTERNAL EVIDENCE (must be carried, downweights this rank): research/findings/2026-08-25-vision-nonlinear-2layer-granule-expansion-readout-does-not-lift-the-c2-linear-ceiling.md - a two-layer nonlinear granule-expansion spiking readout did NOT lift a linear ceiling on a related vision crux; the read-fidelity arc explicitly ranks nonlinearity-alone as cautioned.
ranked_shortlist.first_derisk: Cheap post-hoc numpy reanalysis of already-collected structure-characterization traces (CPU-pool, no substrate build). MANDATORY anti-cheat fix from adversarial verify: a HELD-OUT train/test split (fit per-subunit logistics on one half of trials, correlate on the other) so a correlation rise cannot come from in-sample overfit to the K x subset extra parameters; the identity-shuffle control (scramble which neuron feeds which subset, param count fixed) alone does NOT rule out 'more free parameters wins'.
ranked_shortlist.go_gate: Cheap-gate: held-out weight_cosine_to_head_diag (or held-out decode) with K subunits EXCEEDS the single-linear baseline beyond BOTH the identity-shuffle null AND held-out CV, at >=5/6 seeds, with the gain NOT reproduced by the shuffle control. Only then fund the real build (genuine NMDA-like nonlinear conductance dynamics in the read - an engineering lift, not a wiring change) + a decisive 6-seed GPU run at the rank-1 integrated bar.
ranked_shortlist.lane: CPU-pool (cheap de-risk) -> agent-build (real nonlinear conductance, opus-tier design) -> small-GPU-queue (decisive)
ranked_shortlist.expected_cost: Cheap de-risk: hours CPU-pool, offline reanalysis (~half day, no GPU). Full build: genuine moderate agent-build. Priced BELOW its raw cheapness because the vision-2layer NO-GO lowers its prior probability of clearing.
ranked_shortlist.verdict_conditional_note: If pending readout GOes: park it - nonlinearity-alone is the weakest-supported family given the vision precedent, run only if idle CPU and ranks 1-3 are exhausted. If FLAT AND rank-3 returns NOT-information-limited: promote the candidate-4 (compose-with-incumbent) form as a cheap parallel refinement of rank 1's basal read; if rank-3 returns information-limited, this same-K-subunit-in-same-population refinement is predicted futile and should be deprioritized behind the independent-pathway levers.

ranked_shortlist.mechanism: Fixed sparse-K random expansion recoding: a fixed sparse-K (K~4-10) random expansion population (M~10-30x hidden size), each unit summing a small non-overlapping random subset of hid/hidinh through a threshold nonlinearity at ~10% coding level; the existing softmax/Hebbian word-pool read operates on this expanded code instead of raw dense hid/hidinh. Diagnosed (given candidate 7, folded in as ONE combined sweep) via population-decorrelation eigenvalue structure, predicting the advantage grows with a probe direction's structuredness.
ranked_shortlist.grounding: Marr (1969) / Albus (1971) cerebellar expansion recoding; Litwin-Kumar, Harris, Axel, Sompolinsky & Abbott, 'Optimal Degrees of Synaptic Connectivity', Neuron 93:1153-1164 (2017); Cayco-Gajic, Clopath & Silver, 'Sparse synaptic connectivity is required for decorrelation and pattern separation in feedforward networks', Nat Commun 8:1116 (2017). SAME countervailing vision-2layer-granule-expansion NO-GO (2026-08-25) applies with full force - this IS a granule-cell-expansion read.
ranked_shortlist.first_derisk: MANDATORY cheaper prerequisite FIRST (shared with rank 3's bundle): re-run the fresh-build-per-probe structured-vs-random decode check post cache-fix - the closely related cupy structure-characterization wall was RETRACTED as a stale-COO artifact and vanished (0.96 vs 0.95) once fixed, and the softmax-confidence corr~0 finding this leans on has NOT been shown to survive the same fix. If the wall does not re-confirm, this angle is MOOT before any build. If it re-confirms: cheap numpy replay of already-saved hidden activity, K-sweep + shuffle-identity anti-cheat, on the existing structure-characterization harness.
ranked_shortlist.go_gate: Gated on the prerequisite. Cheap-gate: held-out decode / head_w correlation on the K-expanded code EXCEEDS the raw-dense-hid baseline beyond the identity-shuffle null at >=5/6 seeds, with the advantage GROWING with probe structuredness (candidate-7 prediction). Full spiking build (new population + real sparse synapses into the mouth pipeline) is a separate moderate agent-build gated behind that, then a decisive 6-seed GPU run.
ranked_shortlist.lane: CPU-pool (prerequisite recheck + K-sweep) -> agent-build (spiking expansion population) -> small-GPU-queue (decisive)
ranked_shortlist.expected_cost: Cheap de-risk if the wall re-confirms (numpy replay, hours). Full build moderate. Effective cost RAISED by two gates in front of it (wall-recheck + rank-3 information-limiting verdict) either of which can moot it.
ranked_shortlist.verdict_conditional_note: If pending readout GOes: do not fund - a same-population recoding for the deep plateau only, behind two gates and the vision NO-GO. If FLAT: run ONLY the cheap prerequisite recheck first; a same-population expansion is exactly what rank-3's information-limiting verdict would predict futile, so it should not be built ahead of confirming the noise is NOT information-limited.

ranked_shortlist.mechanism: Ensemble WIRING FIX (repair of the INERT --sub-pop lever): route each of P read clones to its OWN disjoint sub-population of hid/hidinh, independently OU-noised and confirmed spiking, instead of all clones sharing one deterministic conductance drive - so within-group pooling averages genuinely independent noise (a real sqrt(P) gain, the mechanism that made the 2026-08-13 few-spike population-coding GO work).
ranked_shortlist.grounding: The ensemble --sub-pop lever was found INERT BY CONSTRUCTION (research/findings/2026-08-27-mouth-read-snr-ensemble-verdict-and-dendritic-lever.md): pool members are DETERMINISTIC CONDUCTANCE REPLICAS of one shared noisy hidden population (OU noise injected as CURRENT, pools never spike), so summing cancels the common-mode noise exactly (bit-identical 0.4977 at sub-pop 1 and 2). Population averaging reduces read noise ONLY when members carry INDEPENDENT noise - the honest fix is to make them independent. Grounded in standard population-coding sqrt(P) SNR gain.
ranked_shortlist.first_derisk: Pure wiring change to the already-built harness: give each read clone a disjoint independently-OU-noised sub-population, P={1,2,4} sweep at existing seed counts, no new mechanism. Anti-cheat: confirm cross-pool conductance correlation < 1 (the independence fingerprint the INERT version lacked).
ranked_shortlist.go_gate: Cheap-gate: sub_learned_recov rises monotonically with P over {1,2,4} beyond the bit-identical-cancellation null at >=5/6 seeds, specifically sub_learned_recov(P=4) - sub_learned_recov(P=1) >= a pre-set lift (e.g. +0.05) versus the OLD shared-drive ensemble's 0.000. If GO at cheap scale, confirm at 6-seed production B=48.
ranked_shortlist.expected_cost: Cheap - pure wiring change to an existing harness, no new mechanism to construct. Small-GPU or CPU-pool.
ranked_shortlist.verdict_conditional_note: If pending readout GOes: low-priority idle-lane curiosity for the deep plateau. If FLAT: run it, but it is VULNERABLE to rank-3's verdict - giving each clone its own DOWNSTREAM sub-pop still shares the UPSTREAM hidden common-mode, so if the limit is information-limiting it will re-hit the same wall one level up. Sequence it AFTER rank 3 so the diagnostic can predict whether independent downstream pools are enough.

ranked_shortlist.mechanism: PLASTIC sparse-K expansion (refinement of rank 5): the K nonzero input synapses per expansion unit become locally plastic under an unsupervised pre/post-only Hebbian/BCM/Oja rule (no host gradient, no teacher), driven by ordinary mouth-training exposure, so the expansion geometry reorganizes toward task-relevant structured directions instead of depending on a single random draw.
ranked_shortlist.grounding: BCM: Bienenstock, Cooper & Munro, J Neurosci 2:32-48 (1982); Oja, J Math Biol 15:267-273 (1982). Motivated by the candidate's cited 2026 granule-cell-geometry-reorients-with-learning result (UNVERIFIED - flagged as a claim, not a resolved citation; treat as design motivation only until a binding doc anchors it with a source quote). Inherits the vision-2layer-granule-expansion NO-GO caveat.
ranked_shortlist.first_derisk: DO NOT FUND YET (non-actionable by its own logic): only worth pursuing if rank 5's FIXED-random expansion first moves the needle - 'if the fixed version is flat, plasticity has nothing to reorganize'. When actionable: CPU-pool numpy reusing rank-5's scaffold plus a BCM/Oja update over already-logged pre/post activity, no GPU, no new sim run.
ranked_shortlist.go_gate: Deferred. When actionable: held-out decode after N epochs of BCM/Oja reorganization EXCEEDS the fixed-random draw (rank 5) at >=5/6 seeds, with a frozen-plasticity control isolating the reorganization from the raw expansion.
ranked_shortlist.expected_cost: Cheap in isolation but effectively unfunded now - gated behind rank 5 showing signal AND the wall-survives-cache-fix prerequisite AND (per rank 3) a not-information-limited verdict.
ranked_shortlist.verdict_conditional_note: Independent of the pending readout in the near term - it is downstream of rank 5 either way. If FLAT and rank 5 clears its cheap gate with a not-information-limited verdict, this becomes the highest-CEILING recoding lever; otherwise it stays parked. Lowest actionability of the shortlist.
